name: Soniox STT
blurb: Multilingual real-time and async STT — Soniox v5 adds stronger speaker separation, endpointing, and structured speech recognition.
about: Soniox STT currently offers stt-rt-v5 for real-time transcription and stt-async-v5 for recorded audio. The June 2026 v5 releases improve accuracy across more than 60 languages, speaker separation, spoken-language identification, semantic endpointing, context handling, and recognition of structured speech such as numbers, dates, emails, names and codes.

The service is cloud-hosted with WebSocket real-time and asynchronous APIs, and includes multilingual transcription, speaker separation and translation capabilities. Public pricing is approximately $0.12/hour for real-time and $0.10/hour for async transcription under the standard usage assumptions. Soniox is not present in the current Open ASR result export, so no WER is assigned here.
install:
pip install -U soniox

# Set SONIOX_API_KEY, then use the SDK's real-time or async STT client.
# Current real-time model: stt-rt-v5
